resources.string: Look for OpenCode on computers on this Wi-Fi.
To find your computer, the app looks at devices on your Wi-Fi network. It sends no password and only asks nearby addresses.
Start OpenCode on your computer with `opencode serve --mdns`, make sure both are on the same Wi-Fi, or enter the address yourself.
Without access to your local network the app cannot look for your computer. You can allow it and try again, or enter the address yourself.
Local network access is turned off for this app. Turn it on in the app settings, or enter the address yourself.
